entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
John Carter, order 884-21B. Look, I'm a bit short on time, just tell me if I can return it or not.
Of course, Mr. Carter. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago, on December 22nd.
And? So how do I return it?

Well sir, our policy for the VeloBand Pulse is a bit different from our other items. Due to the nature of the device, it has a strict 10-day return window. We're currently on day 17, which is outside that period.
You can't be serious. I've been dealing with a family emergency. I was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well. Can you tell me a little more about what happened? Just to document the exception request.

It was an emergency, that's all you need to know. The band was a gift for my son before his military deployment, but the hospital stay and surgery threw everything off. The box hasn't even been opened.

I understand completely. Thank you for sharing that. Just to be certain for my report, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or simply a matter of preference given the circumstances?
The issue is that his deployment was moved up because of my surgery, and I couldn't give it to him. I just need to return it. It's not needed anymore. Yes or no?

Yes. Given the medical emergency you've described with the hospital and the military deployment, we can absolutely make a one-time exception for you. I can authorize a full refund. I just need to confirm your email address to send the return label.
Okay, finally. It's j.carter@email.com.

Perfect. I have just processed the return authorization and sent a pre-paid shipping label to that email. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Got the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mr. Carter. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you and your son the very best.
